Q: Thank you for taking the time to sepak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision
you reported in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing right before the collision?
A: I was on the main road in Conroe, in the right lane, and I needed to move over to the left lane because my exit was
coming up. I checked my mirror and signaled, and I started to change lanes.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?
A: Not really. I looked, but I didn't see anything beside me. Then I felt a bump and heard a loud scrape on the side of
my car. The other vehicle was already alongside me when I noticed it.
Q: Did either vehicle stop after the contact?
A: We both pulled over onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and we talked for a minute, then we exchanged
information.
Q: Did you go to a medical facility afterward?
A: Yes, I went that evening. My right shoulder was sore right away, and by the next morning I could barely lift my arm
above my head. They told me it looked like a strain and gave me some medication and a sling for a few days.
Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment for the shoulder?
A: I have a follow-up with my doctor next week, and I'm doing some basic stretches at home. It still hurts when I reach
for things or drive for long periods.
Q: Is there anything else about the collision you'd like to add?
A: Just that I was trying to be careful. I signaled and checked, and I still ended up getting hit.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
